unit_of_analysis: seed (mean over the seed's two cases); case-level reported as secondary

communication.note: equal weights, min-max normalised per case; no tuning against labels

spatial.note: score = 1/(1+d_min/scale) over observations overlapping +/-window of the incident; no observation in window -> 0

tie_break: descending raw score, then ascending sha256(dataset_id|case_ref|candidate) - independent of reference order and of labels

statistics.effect_size: matched-pairs rank-biserial r and Cohen d_z
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across all method pairs within each metric
